method: One AXValue edit per operation; ScreenCaptureKit at 60 Hz; mean RGB change over the photo canvas only
clock: CMSampleBuffer presentation timestamp aligned to Date wall clock at capture start
limitations: Single sample per operation, not a statistically qualified median
AXValue editing is not a physical slider drag
Mean canvas change does not prove every final tile has settled
Texture 25 produced no detectable canvas mean change and is excluded
These timings cannot be compared directly with RAWMaster API-return timings
